title: Review Package and Versioned Reproduction
paragraphs:
Appendix L
Review Package and Versioned Reproduction
The reviewer directory is a curated copy of available materials, not a claim
that missing evidence has been recovered. Its index and checksummed manifest
identify included les, unavailable artifacts, and verication status. Source text,
compiled output when available, reference records, diagrams, input schemas, and
reproducibility utilities are supplied without editorial scratch les. Methodological
disclosure and the planned experiment protocol remain part of the scientic record.
L.1
Available and Pending Evidence
Thesis and diagrams
LaTeX sources, native vector diagrams, portable Mermaid sources, and the
compiled PDF when compilation succeeds.
Reported results
Historical numerical tables already present in the thesis, explicitly distin-
guished from newly recomputed results.
Field evidence: available
Original 60-row questionnaire responses, the reconstructed 52-row analysis
matrix, and the exclusion key. Instrument provenance, signed consent records,

and independently keyed factual answers remain pending.
FGD transcript: available
The original 160-segment transcript, the four-domain synthesis in Appendix G,
and the design-only simulation bundle. The audiovisual recordings and partic-
ipant roster remain unavailable; disputed candidate quotations remain outside
participant datasets.
Qualitative evidence: available
Pseudonymised ride/PO accounts, the researcher self-report audio and its 185-
segment GPU transcript, coding decisions, and the four qualitative corpora.
Participant recordings and the focus-group roster remain unavailable.
Context and corpus: available
Four corpora (Uber reviews, student social-media, student-lifestyle, Reuters
DNR manifest). Uber statements, linkage documentation, usage permissions,
and independently adjudicated factual keys remain pending.
Historical software: partially available
The v8 pipeline, environment record, seeds, posterior draws, execution logs,
and generated outputs are included. The original platform backend and client
sources remain pending.
Identiable records are not automatically copied to the reviewer package. An ex-
plicit source-register release decision is required; approval to conduct research is not
automatically permission for unrestricted le distribution.

L.2
Regeneration Without Silent Changes
From the project root, run
python 02_code/pipeline/loklok_pipeline_v8.py root .
embedding-model BAAI/bge-m3 device cuda
The workow validates input schemas and records le hashes. New approved survey
records produce a separately labelled update appendix with actual sample counts,
scoring rules, missingness, descriptive statistics, reliability, and correlations. Histor-
ical numbers remain a historical baseline: no script silently rewrites the meaning of
an earlier dataset or claims to repeat a model whose code is absent. Each changed
input creates a new content-addressed snapshot.
Manuscript interpretation still
requires researcher review.
The source register records evidence type, le location, provenance, veri-
cation, and release status.
A focus-group record cannot be promoted to factual
ground truth merely by changing its lename.
New qualitative content requires
documented coding decisions; the pipeline does not automatically invent themes or
quotations. Additional analyses become executable only when the corresponding
validated estimator and inputs are supplied.
L.3
Research Notes and Graph
The linked-note graph separates theory, variables, observations, model outputs, and
pending evidence. Its editable JSON notes have stable identiers, source pointers,
and explicit relationships. An oine HTML graph and portable Mermaid source

are generated from those same records. Notes assist navigation; their links are not
empirical causal estimates.
L.4
Submission Checks
The manuscript uses authordate references, a hanging-indent reference list, num-
bered chapters and equations, lists of tables and gures, and separated appendices.
The ocial Ahram Canadian University programme handbook, approved title word-
ing, committee forms, ethics documentation, abstract-length rules, and submission
requirements have not been supplied. A similarly named institution's handbook is
not substituted. Formatting here is therefore a working thesis format, not certica-
tion of institutional compliance.
